conventions: עָמַד rendered 'stood fast' (33.9) and 'standeth fast' (33.11) keeps 'fast' with the verb: the standing-firm sense is the verb's own lexeme in this psalm, so 'fast' is not a surplus particle under rule 44. Competing reading marks 'fast' added; applied uniformly in both verses.

A participial predicate with no written subject in the verse (אֹהֵב 33.5, כֹּנֵס and נֹתֵן 33.7) takes the ASV's supplied 'He' into its own unit under rule 17, since the participle is the clause's predicate and no other morpheme in the verse denotes the subject. Competing reading marks 'He' added under rule 20's closing sentence; the chapter applies the rule-17 reading throughout.

וַיֶּהִי 'and it was done' is read as the whole rendering of הָיָה 'came to be' (rule 21), whereas the italic 'done' of 33.4 'is done in faithfulness', a verbless clause, is added under rule 20. The difference is the presence of the verb, not a split.
report: Read all 22 verses end to end, including the three added units (33.4 done, 33.12 whom, 33.17 any), against the 27-lemma candidate table. No cross-verse split found; every multi-treatment bucket is the ASV rendering the morpheme differently.

Article handling is contract-consistent across the chapter: arthrous rectum with two written the's gives each its own (33.7 מֵי הַיָּם, 33.14 יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ); anarthrous rectum with one the fronts it to the article (33.13 בְּנֵי הָאָדָם); article beside an ASV a/no is unrepresented (33.7, 33.16, 33.17, 33.19).

Prepositions left bare by recasting are unrepresented where the ASV writes nothing (33.8 מֵיְהוָה 'fear Jehovah', 33.15 אֶל 'considereth all their works', 33.12 reflexive לוֹ) and take the word where one is written (33.8 מִמֶּנּוּ 'of him'); not a split.

33.4 'done' added vs 33.9 'it was done' on הָיָה is licensed: 33.4 is verbless (bare 'is in faithfulness' says what the Hebrew says) while 33.9 writes וַיֶּהִי, whose whole rendering 'it was done' is the verb's under rule 21.
עָמַד → 'stood fast' / 'standeth fast' kept whole in both 33.9 and 33.11; participial predicates with no written subject take the ASV's He in 33.5 and 33.7. Both consistent; recorded as conventions.
BSB disagreements (33.8 מִן, 33.15 אֶל, 33.11 וָ and second דֹר, 33.16/33.17 הַ) are all documented convention differences under rules 40, 22 and 29; none is an error.
No promotion or amendment: nothing here generalises beyond what the contract already states, and no corpus precedent was supplied for the participle-subject question to carry a rule.
